svg.title: Brain with its Work column
svg.desc: Brain on a wide screen. The menu is docked on the left. The conversation shows the goal line 'Ship atlas-notes v1.4 this week, 2 of 5 back', your message, a folded 'Worked, 6 steps' row and three Work slips: Ready, Needs review and Failed. The Work column on the right groups Work as Needs you, Running, Back and Waiting; the cat perches on the slip that needs you.
svg.text: Keep both copies, or the newest edit?
Ship atlas-notes v1.4 this week · 2 of 5 back
Ship atlas-notes v1.4 this week: fix the sync bug,
tidy the settings copy, write release notes.
On it. Five parts, each tracked as Work. I'll only call you when it matters.
Five apps compared. “Conflicted copy” wins 3 of 5.
41 pass, but 2 were flaky and needed a retry.
Notion said 401: the token expired. Nothing was posted.
